test_cases.name: TC01_Provider_InitialState_Unconfigured_Diagnostics
test_cases.description: Verifies provider initial state before configuration: generation=0, IsCached=false, null entries.

test_cases.name: TC02_Provider_ConfigurePolicy_MonotonicGenerationAdvance
test_cases.description: Verifies configuring expected package policy advances generation monotonically and binds policy.

test_cases.name: TC03_Provider_ReconfigureSamePolicy_AdvancesGeneration
test_cases.description: Verifies reconfiguring with the identical policy advances generation monotonically.

test_cases.name: TC04_Provider_ExplicitInvalidate_AdvancesGeneration
test_cases.description: Verifies R14 explicit InvalidateCache() advances generation by +1 under lock and clears cached items.

test_cases.name: TC05_Provider_ClearConfiguredPolicy_AdvancesGeneration
test_cases.description: Verifies ClearConfiguredExpectedPackagePolicy advances generation and clears policy.

test_cases.name: TC06_StandaloneCore_InitialState_Clean
test_cases.description: Verifies isolated ContentProfileCacheCore instance starts clean with generation=0 and null entry.

test_cases.name: TC07_StandaloneCore_ConfigurePolicy_GenerationAdvance
test_cases.description: Verifies core.ConfigureExpectedPackagePolicy advances generation to 1 and binds policy.

test_cases.name: TC08_StandaloneCore_CaptureStateSnapshot_MatchesGenerationAndPolicy
test_cases.description: Verifies core.CaptureStateSnapshot returns consistent generation and cloned policy record.

test_cases.name: TC09_StandaloneCore_PublishCoherentEntry_NormalMatching_Success
test_cases.description: Verifies publishing a matching entry at current generation populates core cache successfully.

test_cases.name: TC10_StandaloneCore_TryGetCoherentEntry_ReturnsMatchingSnapshot
test_cases.description: Verifies TryGetCoherentEntry returns coherent immutable snapshot with exact metadata.

test_cases.name: TC11_StandaloneCore_DefensiveManifestImmutability_ResistsCallerMutation
test_cases.description: Verifies CachedManifest returns defensive copy: mutating caller instance does not affect cached state.

test_cases.name: TC12_StandaloneCore_InvalidateCache_AdvancesGeneration_ClearsEntry
test_cases.description: Verifies InvalidateCache on populated core advances generation from 1 to 2 and clears entry.

test_cases.name: TC13_StandaloneCore_ReconfigureToNewPolicy_AdvancesGeneration_ClearsOldCache
test_cases.description: Verifies reconfiguring populated core to Policy B advances generation to 2 and clears old cache.

test_cases.name: TC14_StandaloneCore_PublishNewPolicyEntry_NormalMatching_Success
test_cases.description: Verifies publishing entry for Policy B at generation 2 populates core successfully.

test_cases.name: TC15_R12_PackageOrder_LoadOrderZeroBasedSorting
test_cases.description: Regresses R12 package order: verifies 0-based contiguous loadOrder sorting normalizes activeMods.

test_cases.name: TC16_R12_PackageOrder_PhysicalPermutationInvariance
test_cases.description: Regresses R12: verifies aligned and permuted manifests produce identical canonical JSON and fingerprint.

test_cases.name: TC17_R12_PackageOrder_DistinctValidSequences_MatchSeparatePolicies
test_cases.description: Verifies R12 separate valid execution orders match their respective policies without rejection calls.

test_cases.name: TC18_R12_PackageOrder_FreshOriginal_SerializeTrue_BeforeAdmission
test_cases.description: Regresses R12 fresh-original manifest serializes with canonicalNormalize=true before external admission.

test_cases.name: TC19_R11_PolicyDeclaration_Encoding_Whitespace_Unicode_Digest
test_cases.description: Regresses R11 policy declaration compact JSON, whitespace/Unicode preservation, and SHA-256 digest.

test_cases.name: TC20_R9_VersionMeaningSemantics
test_cases.description: Regresses R9 version meaning: modVersion null/empty values preserved without overwrite.

test_cases.name: TC21_ContractVersion_And_CapabilityFlag
test_cases.description: Verifies ADR-006B-v5-R14 contract version and GATE05_R14_POLICY_CAPTURE_PUBLICATION capability flag.

test_cases.name: TC22_DefFamilies_CanonicalSorting
test_cases.description: Regresses Def families deterministic ordinal defName sorting across all supported families.
